# Prepared material joins recurrent chain formation

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For every alphabet and law of draws, a copy of a word produces the word exactly when the pool supplies it and the support covers what it draws; where every unit draws d from one stock and becomes two, n rounds from k units run exactly when the stock covers d·k(2^n−1), ending with k·2^n units. End attachment is the instance with the alternating word and unit draws: within the size limit a chain grows by the alternating word, bonds included, exactly when the pool supplies it and the support covers one unit per token, so the mature chain, bonds included, forms from the empty chain exactly when the pool holds at least four of each kind and eight units are free. From k mature chains with the material for the rounds, n rounds reach k·2^n mature chains exactly when the support covers 9·k(2^n−1), that is, exactly when the doubling process with draw 9 runs n rounds. The previous actual routing output forms the cleavable chain, and its internally connected fragments rebuild under the same attachment law.

Canonical source: [RecurrentAssembly.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/RecurrentAssembly.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- A/B end compatibility, central cleavage of an eight-component path and operation order are supplied; the completed routing output has no unrepresented load-bearing edges.
- Continuing one complete chain for g rounds requires 8(2^g−1) additional components and 9(2^g−1) support; structural activation from routed material additionally requires eight support units.

Structure consists of actual token transfers, formed edges, filtered old edges and retained fragments. The new attachment route and old division growth have only the checked endpoint correspondence.
